summary: Quarterly audit completed using guarded write rules. Low-risk local and documentation-oriented MCPs remain the recommended always-on core. Account-scoped or workflow-specific integrations stay in the on-demand registry. No connector changes were implemented in this run.
next_actions: Keep the current always-on core centered on local filesystem, git, docs, lint, and static analysis primitives.
Treat GitHub, Notion, Linear, design tools, deploy tools, observability, and infrastructure endpoints as on-demand only.
Fix the missing npm runtime before making Playwright a required core step.
Only approve writes for Notion, Linear, GitHub, Slack, or Cloudinary after destination and credential mappings are explicit.

suggested_actions.title: Trim the default stack to low-risk core MCPs
suggested_actions.proposed_change: Prefer always-on local filesystem, git, docs, lint, and static-analysis servers; move account-scoped connectors behind explicit task triggers.

suggested_actions.title: Keep workflow sinks gated until mappings exist
suggested_actions.proposed_change: Do not mark Notion, Linear, GitHub, Slack, or Cloudinary as implemented until destination and credential mappings are explicitly approved.
